ogDescription:
Ace Real Estate proudly presents 10 Spoonbill Close, Williams Landing - a fully renovated family home that delivers space, comfort, and exceptional lifestyle convenience in one of the area's most sought-after pockets within Wyndham Waters estate.
This home offers seamless access to everything that makes Williams Landing so desirable. Enjoy easy connectivity to the Princes Freeway, making commuting to Melbourne CBD or Geelong effortless. Williams Landing Train Station is just minutes away, providing a reliable public transport option for daily commuters.
Perfectly positioned in a quiet street, almost cul-de-sac, adjoining a walking trail, providing extra privacy and sunlight from the north side windows. A couple of minutes' walks to the council-maintained water body, perfect for an outdoor run or family walk alongside ducks. A couple of minutes' walks on the other side to Wyndham Waters Leisure Centre, with exclusive resident's access to a fully equipped gym, tennis court and a swimming pool. After a gym workout or tennis game, you can relax in the Sauna or Steam Room or enjoy a family meal in the dedicated BBQ area.
Inside, the home showcases a well-designed floorplan featuring multiple living zones, ensuring there's space for everyone to relax, work, and entertain. The expansive open-plan kitchen, dining, and living area forms the heart of the home, complemented by a separate lounge for added flexibility.
Step outside to a large undercover pergola - perfect for year-round entertaining, weekend barbecues, or simply unwinding in your private outdoor space. Property Features:
• Fully renovated throughout - move-in ready
• Four spacious bedrooms including master with ensuite and walk-in robe • Multiple living areas including open-plan living/dining and separate lounge • Well-appointed kitchen with waterfall island bench and pantry
• Six split-system air conditioning units for zoned comfort
• Evaporative cooling throughout the home
• Large undercover pergola - ideal for entertaining
• Solar panel system for energy efficiency and reduced bills
• Zip HydroTap with instant hot and cold filtered water
• Central bathroom plus separate toilet
• Double remote garage with internal access
• Functional laundry with external access
• Ample storage including linen cupboards
You're also surrounded by an array of shopping and lifestyle amenities, including Williams Landing Shopping Centre, nearby Point Cook Town Centre, and a variety of local cafes,
restaurants, and everyday conveniences. Reputable schools, parks, walking tracks, and childcare facilities are all within close proximity, making this an ideal location for growing families.
Offering a perfect combination of modern upgrades, generous space, and unbeatable location, this is a home that truly ticks all the boxes.
